name: Feature proposal
about: Propose a bounded improvement for consideration in the controlled roadmap
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

Describe the concrete problem or limitation. Avoid proposing implementation before the problem is clear.

## Evidence

What reproducible evidence shows that this problem is worth solving?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the smallest useful outcome, not a broad redesign.

## Roadmap fit

Which current or future work package should own this proposal, and why should it be placed there?

A proposal does not change the controlled roadmap or authorise implementation by itself.

## Trust-boundary impact

Explain any effect on filesystem access, Git authority, credentials, network access, model/provider identity, hidden verification, telemetry or external actions.

## Alternatives considered

Include simpler approaches, including doing nothing or removing complexity.

## Verification

Describe how the outcome could be tested deterministically and what evidence would justify promotion.
